query:
SELECT
                stops.id,
                stops.stop_code,
                stops.name,
                stops.lng,
                stops.lat,
                stops.province,
                stops.smart,
                stops.type,
                stops.disabled_can_use,
                stops.physical,
                stops.city
            FROM
                line_stops
                RIGHT JOIN stops ON stops.stop_code = line_stops.stop_code
            WHERE
                line_stops.line_code = $1
                AND line_stops.city = $3
                AND line_stops.route_code = $1 || '_' || $2 || '_D0'
            ORDER BY
                line_stops.stop_order
